instrument.question: Will Delcy Rodríguez be the leader of Venezuela end of 2026?

event.finding: Physical return to Venezuela corroborated by Reuters and Guardian reporting and opposition-team images; her direct official post could not be retrieved. A return increases opposition organizing capacity; it does not itself appoint a head of state.
event.Reuters_facts: Reuters reports a Lara church appearance, planned meetings and efforts to obtain an election date. Its same-day report says Trump suggested continued support for Rodriguez; no fresh electoral schedule or government transfer is established.
event.Guardian_scope: Exact article confirms return; frozen earlier and updated headline versions retained.
event.BBC_gap: Exact BBC page inaccessible through the SDK; return corroborated separately, not an assertion that its body was read.
